purpose: Repeat the useful P2D geometry-feature signal with fresh initialization and collocation seeds and evaluate its budget dependence across complete accuracy, spatial, engineering and resource families. No single supplementary metric veto and no post-hoc favorable checkpoint selection.
representation: Exactly the closed P2D implementations: full 1000 half-Fourier inputs, or K fixed Gaussian inputs plus 1000-K global Fourier features. Frozen P2D geometry and uniform-scale centres/widths. All three use the same initialized downstream 1000-100-100-5 network and 110705 trainable parameters. All hidden layers train; no ELM, amplitude parameters or new geometry tuning.
sampling: For each geometry and seed regenerate the P2A shared_points recipe using the same frozen geometry/local-uniform support-probe covers from P2A: 6000 interior points, 90% uniform mean plus 10% support-probe mean, 500 per outer edge, 1000 arc-weighted cavity points. Seed stream 100000+seed. All methods receive byte-identical points/weights within each pair; C1 and C8 share the circle points. Uniform/RBF control centres are not substituted for the old fixed probe recipe. No resampling during a trajectory and no FEM-guided sampling.
budget: 27 continuous trajectories, no optimizer reset at checkpoints. Always report all three fixed endpoints. If legitimate convergence stops early, retain the terminal with actual work and carry that unchanged state to later nominal endpoints with an explicit early-stop flag; never substitute a FEM-best saved checkpoint. Numerical failure stops the batch. No early termination based on observed method rankings.
precision: Float32, TF32 off, deterministic PyTorch algorithms, process CPU threads 2, one project GPU computation at a time.
preflight: Hash-check closed P2D code/geometry and P2A support covers. Six new geometry/seed point sets; validate solid membership, normalized weights, boundary normals, Gaussian collocation response, equal counts and identical downstream initialization. Independent objective/parameter-gradient autograd check for all 18 geometry/seed/method combinations and full-batch finite GPU gradients. An unchanged baseline dependency is reused rather than modified.
freeze: Freeze all 27 terminal states and all reached registered checkpoints, full accepted-step/closure traces, source/protocol/input hashes before any new FEM evaluation. Evaluate all 81 case/seed/method/budget combinations after the complete fit phase. Existing P2A FEM reference arrays and geometry masks are read only after freeze; verify their provenance and hashes.

evaluation.accuracy: Area and original point/node relative L2 U/S, wall U, vector MAE, 50/90/95/99% weighted error quantiles and maxima. Keep conventions separate.
evaluation.spatial: Fixed near/far-wall and corner masks from the frozen FEM reference; paired improved-area and wall-length fractions for both controls, worst-one-percent-area squared-error mass. Save complete fields and error norms.
evaluation.engineering: Fixed crown/invert/right/left displacement vectors and vertical/horizontal convergence, signed values and absolute errors. Do not divide by near-zero components.
evaluation.resources: Parameters, actual accepted steps, closure counts and peak allocated/reserved GPU memory; preparation and run durations are development telemetry only. No formal timing inference.
evaluation.aggregation: Paired ratios per seed, arithmetic mean/sample SD/median/range across the three NEW seeds and counts of favorable pairs, reported separately for each case, metric and budget. Do not pool the exploratory seed 260926 into confirmation summaries. No seed-level confidence or universal superiority claim from n=3.
evaluation.targets: Research target tuples (area U%, area S%, wall U%): (5,20,10), (2,10,5), (1,5,2). For each model/seed report the first observed registered endpoint meeting all three, if any, and whether all later endpoints also meet it. No interpolation between checkpoints or time-to-accuracy claim; thresholds are not engineering acceptance limits.

interpretation: Primary benefit to examine is L1 global/wall displacement at matched fixed budgets and its geometry-rule gain versus uniform-scale features; also inspect C1 displacement and the full C8 trade-off. Mark an individual prespecified benefit as consistent within this study when all three paired seeds favor it; report magnitude, other outcomes and both controls regardless. At least 10% geometric-mean paired reduction distinguishes a material research signal from a small directional change, not a universal pass/fail gate. Stress, convergence, error tails and resources constrain any proposed claim. A new favorable metric or selected budget cannot be called independent confirmation without its declared context.
stop: Close after the fixed 27 trajectories and complete evaluations. Do not extend iterations, replace a seed, adjust Gaussian scale/bandwidth, add T1/S1 or choose a favorable checkpoint within this protocol. Stop dependent work on missing inputs, changed hashes, nonfinite state, insufficient memory or concurrent project GPU computation; preserve and report the issue.
original_anchoring: Original C1 versus original-bandwidth Fourier remains a separate frozen result. This batch does not establish independent original-anchoring benefit; prior anchored/independent controls remain reported in P2D.
